content.short: GenWealth is a decentralized inheritance and recovery solution on Cardano that secures your digital legacy.
content.description: GenWealth is a decentralized application on Cardano that provides secure solutions for crypto inheritance and wallet recovery. Funded through Project Catalyst, the platform allows users to set up 'dead man's switches' and on-chain recovery rules to ensure their digital assets are never lost. Users can define specific beneficiaries and distribute their wealth according to legal compliance and personal preference without relying on centralized intermediaries. By bridging the gap between blockchain tech and traditional law, GenWealth empowers individuals to protect their digital legacy.
content.meta: GenWealth offers Cardano-based crypto inheritance and decentralized wallet recovery solutions. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
